comparison.objective: Stand a picture frame stably on a narrow ledge; candidate fractures and collects four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Placement and balance on limited support versus recessed mandrel alignment, hammering, withdrawal, and millimetre fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Frame remains standing on the ledge versus four fractured/contained tangs with no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Static balance placement is a different tested ability and outcome. No spec versions, ledge dimensions, or stability duration are supplied.
